Q3: How do I make the payment for RTI fee?
A: After filling the first page of the RTI request form, a non-BPL applicant has to click on "Make
                            Payment" button for payment of the prescribed RTI fee.
The applicant can pay the prescribed RTI fee through eChallan payment gateway through the
                            following modes:
Internet banking.
ATM-cum-Debit card.
Credit/Debit card of Master/Visa.
UPI
It may be noted that no RTI fee is required to be paid by a citizen who is below poverty line, as
                            per RTI Rules, 2012. However, the BPL applicant must attach a copy of the certificate issued by
                            the appropriate government in this regard, along with the application.
